link.note: His mother Deborah Topping/Tapping of Brookhaven's place in the Topping line is not traced; if a granddaughter of Capt. Elnathan Topping he would be about 2C8R.

summary: Founder of Litchfield Law School and brother-in-law of Aaron Burr; possible Topping cousin.
bio: Mother Deborah Topping/Tapping (m. Rev. Abner Reeve Dec 1743; d. 1759 aged 42). Rev. Abner Reeve preached at Moriches 1754–63 and in 1763 'removed with a company of emigrants from that neighborhood to Blooming Grove, Orange County' (Dexter vol. 1 pp. 434–5) — a possible vehicle for the Tuthill/Smith move.
sources: F. B. Dexter, Biographical Sketches of the Graduates of Yale College vol. 1 pp. 434–5, https://archive.org/details/biogsketchgrad01dextuoft
